obligations.mechanism: guard.CheckResponse validates the result against the pending request's embedded JSON schema before acceptance (internal/guard/guard.go)
guard.CheckResponse refuses any response whose sequence is not the pending operation's, and refuses rewriting completed sequences (internal/guard/guard.go)
engine.terminate calls guard.CheckCompletion before appending run.completed (internal/engine/engine.go)
guard.CheckCompletion refuses completion when any requirement failed; the SDKs make completion structurally unreachable past a failed Require (internal/guard/guard.go; sdk/*)
SDK Blocked terminal maps to run.blocked in engine.terminate; only the program can raise it (sdk/*; internal/engine/engine.go)
SDK Refused terminal maps to run.refused in engine.terminate (sdk/*; internal/engine/engine.go)
guard.CheckDigest only rebinds under the explicit --accept-new-digest flag; digest.migrated is logged (internal/guard/guard.go; internal/engine/engine.go)
guard rejections are appended to the run log as response.rejected and surfaced as typed errors (internal/engine/engine.go rejected())
protocol.ValidateResult compiles the embedded schema and rejects non-conforming results at the acceptance boundary (internal/protocol/protocol.go)
engine.StartRun is the only run creator; runlog.Create refuses to overwrite an existing run (internal/runlog/runlog.go)
operations enter the log only via engine.advance from a decoded ProgramOutput; the SDKs emit exactly one output per execution (internal/engine/engine.go; sdk/*)
obligations.refusing_test: conformance.TestCrossLanguageTraceEquality (operation stream observed identical across languages, IR-validated)

obligations.mechanism: single-writer inventory: every run-state mutation is a runlog.Append in engine.go/runlog.go; the guard reconstructs state exclusively from the log
obligations.refusing_test: runlog.TestOpenRefusesBrokenSequence (out-of-band edits break the monotone sequence and are refused on open); conformance suite observes all event types
